label: EBF1::PDGFRB

sections.text: EBF1 encodes a transcription factor required for B-cell lineage specification.
PDGFRB encodes platelet-derived growth factor receptor beta, a receptor tyrosine kinase.
The fusion retains the carboxy-terminal kinase domain and creates constitutive growth signaling. EBF1::PDGFRB is an ABL-class kinase lesion in Ph-like B-ALL.
ABL-class kinase inhibition has a biological and preclinical rationale in this fusion class; treatment of Ph-like ALL with these agents is distinct from the BCR::ABL1-positive ALL drug indications.
